_about: Single words that the GeoNames cities1000 file (rules/gazetteer/us.json) lists as place names but that, in a search query, are ordinary words. The effective gazetteer (lib-text.mjs gazetteer()) drops them, drops entries written in capitals of 2-4 letters (airport-style codes), and drops single-word names that are stop words or intent-modifier words. This is a deviation from shipgate, which uses the file as is (spec section 9.2 rule 1 and web-delivery section 12 would then treat these words as places). Set PEWP_GAZETTEER_LITERAL=1 for the spec-literal behaviour.
_source: Collisions found on 2026-10-22 by looking up ~300 common search words in rules/gazetteer/us.json (GeoNames cities1000: e.g. Home KS, Price UT, Worth IL, Deal NJ, Day FL, Law, Pro, Town, Area, Main, Center, Central, Market, Old). The word list is authored here, not fetched from a published list.
